id: title:Gilbert09:name a network cause when a connect attempt fails at setup

review.posthog_relevance: Diagnostic quality improvement for MSSQL warehouse connection failures, helping warehouse users distinguish between authentication and network reachability issues.
review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F2.H1 replaces generic connection failure messages with specific ones identifying network causes (host, port, firewall, SSH tunnel) for MSSQL warehouse sources. This is a substantive, bounded improvement in diagnostic quality and user guidance for warehouse ingestion, without broader systemic architectural changes. Tests are added, supporting the change. review.uncertainty: The exact implementation and test assertions are not fully visible, but the replacement of generic messages with specific ones is a clear, bounded improvement. No evidence of broader systemic risk reduction or adoption. No unverified outcomes inferred.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds two new error message constants and replaces generic connection failure messages with these new, more specific messages. P1.F1.H1 also adds a test case. P1.F2.H1 adds a parametrized test.
observations.posthog_connection: This change improves the diagnostic quality of connection failures for MSSQL warehouse sources.
